legs.name: portability gate (tracked files reference nothing outside this repo)

note: Declared at S11 with the attention package's landing (2026-11-14): the package joins the composed gate in the registry declaration's form — paths discipline, the denylist-carrying portability leg, and the suite in its isolation-wrapped form. The suite proves the serving shell (the explicit store binding's refusal, the mount's route cycle against a fixture store); the pinned repo's own scanner suite and its 7,623-line test tree were not ported — they stand as named findings in the S11 report, not exemptions. The ruff legs (AC-14 cure, 2026-11-15): the package interpreter is its own venv (var/venv, built by init_venv.py over the gate's venvbuild; the pinned ruff==0.17.2 in requirements.txt is the original repo's pin), and the legs run the original's two commands over the package's source roots plus its bootstrap script — the original's RUFF_TARGETS form (its source tree and gate scripts; its tests/ were never a ruff target, and neither are this package's). The ruff config the legs mean is the package's pyproject.toml, the original's [tool.ruff] carried unchanged. The suite leg's state snapshot excludes the venv (exclude_first), the original gate's own isolation form. The import-isolation leg (AC-14 invariant (a), 2026-11-15): the package imports nothing from sibling surfaces — one of the two invariants of the original's unported scanner suite that retained live value, re-expressed as a registry leg (gate.importisolation, the AST component; not gate.isolation, the test-isolation state hash). The date-uniqueness leg (2026-11-16, dup-2026-11-16): one shared date helper per intent per cluster — gate.dateuniqueness over the family map in gate/date_families.json. The import-isolation leg retired from this declaration 2026-11-21: the invariant runs for every composed package by default as the root check's repo-importisolation row; this package's bootstrap exception (init_venv.py importing the gate package's venv builder) is recorded in the gate package's repo leg declaration.
